use_proxy.description: Enable system proxy (set to false to disable)

ui_mode.description: UI modes to start. Allowed values: qml (GUI), webservice (HTTP/JSON), websocket (SDK).

port.description: Port for the webservice. Use 0 to let AusweisApp assign a random port and write it to a file.

bind_addresses.description: IP addresses to bind the webservice/websocket to. By default, only localhost for security.

keep_log.description: Keep log file after exit (default: delete it).

no_logfile.description: Suppress writing log file to ${TMP}/AusweisApp.*.log (logs still go to stdout unless no_loghandler is set).

no_loghandler.description: Disable the default log handler (suppresses stdout logging).
